metadata.industry: Test - Account-level custom ruleset referenced by zone via execute action (T1.1)
metadata.notes: Provisions an account-level custom ruleset with two rules and a zone-level rule that invokes it via action=execute, action_parameters.id=<account_ruleset_id>. Verifies that the migration: (1) re-creates the account ruleset on the destination account, (2) rewrites the zone rule's execute target to point at the NEW dest ID, not the source-account ID, and (3) shows the operation as Verified on the Results page (no Failed rows).
